title: The Living Atlas
notes: Studio concept reel about place: the globe, Miami up close, the Deco atlas of launch cities, the Culture Passport and the Take Me Somewhere instrument. Illustrative motion design only — no location footage. Provisional until approved programming replaces it.

title: Stories in Time
notes: Studio concept reel about time and narrative: the decade dial, explainable connections, THE STORY BEHIND THE STORY and WAVEMAKERS title art. Illustrative artwork, not archival footage. Provisional.

title: The Organism: Sound, Touch & Chrome
notes: Studio concept reel about the platform's sensory identity: chrome logotype, living membrane, sound design preview, cursor language and touch. The sound-design loop is a visual preview; the reel's audio is the generated ambient score. Provisional.

title: Interface Specimens
notes: Studio concept reel of interface specimens: catalogue and player, membership vault, Bauhaus interest categories and search with combined filters. Illustrative UI artwork; titles and counts on screen are placeholders. Provisional.

title: WAVEMAKERS — Teaser
notes: Title-art teaser for the planned original series WAVEMAKERS (Puerto Rico, New York to London). Motion design only; the series is in development and no episode footage exists yet.

title: The Story Behind the Story — Teaser
notes: Title-art teaser for the planned original series THE STORY BEHIND THE STORY. Illustrative collage motion design; no episode footage exists yet.

title: Interior N.Y. Subway, 14th St. to 42nd St. (1905)
attribution: Interior N.Y. Subway, 14th St. to 42nd St. (1905). American Mutoscope & Biograph Co.; camera G. W. "Billy" Bitzer. Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons.
notes: Silent actuality film shot 21 May 1905 on the IRT subway, 14th St–Union Square to the original Grand Central (42nd St). National Film Registry. Library of Congress record: https://www.loc.gov/item/00694394. The downloaded copy carried an added audio track of unknown origin (measured silent, about -91 dB); it was removed with ffmpeg (-an, video stream copied) into source-silent.mp4. No captions: the film has no intertitles.

title: Coney Island at Night (1905)
attribution: Coney Island at Night (1905). Edwin S. Porter, Edison Manufacturing Company. Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons.
notes: Silent film (no audio track) of Coney Island amusement parks lit at night; on-screen titles name Luna Park and Dreamland. No caption file.

title: Kingston Jamaica (1920)
attribution: Kingston Jamaica (1920). Ford Educational Library, Ford Motor Company. US National Archives, via Internet Archive.
notes: Silent film with intertitles. National Archives catalogue: https://catalog.archives.gov/id/91026. The downloaded copy carried an empty audio track (measured about -90 dB mean, -73 dB peak); it was removed with ffmpeg (-an, video stream copied) into source-silent.mp4 so the asset is reported as silent. Source is 720x480 with no aspect-ratio flag. No caption file: the intertitles are on screen.

title: Newspaper Train (1942)
attribution: Newspaper Train (1942). Len Lye, Realist Film Unit, for the UK Ministry of Information. Via Wikimedia Commons.
notes: Narrated wartime film about London newspaper distribution during the Blitz, 1940–41. Captions are human-made, from the Wikimedia Commons TimedText page for this file.

title: Democracy at Work in Rural Puerto Rico (1942)
attribution: Democracy at Work in Rural Puerto Rico (1942). US Department of Agriculture Extension Service; directed by Chester Lindstrom. US National Archives, via Internet Archive.
notes: Narrated US government film depicting rural Puerto Rico around 1941. National Archives catalogue: https://catalog.archives.gov/id/47946. No usable captions exist yet.
